fields.agencyOffice: Office of the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)
fields.formName: Cyber Incident Response Plan (CIRP) Form 4 – Verification Sign-Off

submittedBy.name: Victor Han
submittedBy.title: Chief Technology Officer, Halverson Unified School District

fields.facility: Halverson Unified School District IT Infrastructure (HUSD-FS02, HUSD-DC01, HUSD-VPN01, HUSD-VMS01, HUSD-ERP01)

items.label: Domain Controller Rebuilt
items.value: HUSD-DC01 rebuilt from clean media; krbtgt account reset twice; no active sessions

items.label: Backup Restoration
items.value: Veeam backup from 05:00 (offline tape copy) restored to HUSD-BK01 test environment; full hash verification completed: 98,742,311 files matched

items.label: Data Integrity
items.value: No evidence of tampering; file timestamps verified against pre-incident baseline

items.label: Persistence Detection
items.value: No active persistence or backdoors detected; HUSD-VPN01 preserved as evidence

items.label: C2 IP Confirmed
items.value: 104.214.192.47 matched to known Rhysida group node (CVE-2023-4204 exploit) in CISA threat feed

items.label: Attack Vector
items.value: Unpatched HUSD-VPN01 (CVE-2023-4204); shared local-admin password (admin_husd) on HUSD-DC01

items.label: Data Exfiltration
items.value: Confirmed: 147 files from HUSD-FS02\Health\Share, including 23 IEPs, 12 medication logs, 3 custody orders; exfiltrated prior to encryption

items.label: Ransomware Payload
items.value: hxd32.exe (PID 4012) used to encrypt files; ransom note pushed via HUSD-VPN01 (10.72.10.2) to 32 staff laptops

items.label: Evidence Preservation
items.value: HUSD-VPN01 not wiped, rebooted, or reimaged; forensic image pending CISA dispatch

items.label: Vendor Access Request
items.value: Tyler Munis payroll restore pending signed access request from legal team

items.label: Insurance Notification
items.value: Northwest Schools Risk Pool cyber claims line notified within 24 hours of discovery (per CIRP Section 4.2)

items.label: Law Enforcement Coordination
items.value: FBI Portland Field Office and CISA notified; MS-ISAC and K12 SIX shared indicators (per CIRP Section 5.2)
